scenario.en: Save the file and quit. The buffer already has the right content.
scenario.fr: Sauvegarder le fichier et quitter. Le buffer a déjà le bon contenu.

challenge.initialBuffer:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: nginx
spec:
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx
challenge.expectedBuffer:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: nginx
spec:
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx

explanation.en: `:wq` (or `ZZ` in normal mode — 2 keystrokes) writes and quits.
explanation.fr: `:wq` (ou `ZZ` en mode normal — 2 frappes) écrit et quitte.

scenario.en: Replace every 'nginx' with 'httpd' in the whole buffer, then save.
scenario.fr: Remplacer chaque 'nginx' par 'httpd' dans tout le buffer, puis sauvegarder.

en: `:%s/nginx/httpd/g` — `%` covers the whole buffer, `g` every occurrence.
fr: `:%s/nginx/httpd/g` — `%` couvre tout le buffer, `g` chaque occurrence.

challenge.initialBuffer:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: nginx
spec:
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx
challenge.expectedBuffer:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: httpd
spec:
  containers:
  - name: httpd
    image: httpd

explanation.en: `:%s/nginx/httpd/g` then `:wq`. The `g` flag is critical to catch ALL occurrences.
explanation.fr: `:%s/nginx/httpd/g` puis `:wq`. Le flag `g` est crucial pour TOUTES les occurrences.

scenario.en: Change 'replicas: 1' to 'replicas: 3' (one occurrence). Save and quit.
scenario.fr: Changer 'replicas: 1' en 'replicas: 3' (une seule occurrence). Sauvegarder et quitter.

challenge.initialBuffer:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api
challenge.expectedBuffer:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api

explanation.en: Search with `/replicas` then `n` to position, `f1` to jump to '1', `r3` replaces with '3'. Or `:%s/replicas: 1/replicas: 3/`.
explanation.fr: `/replicas` puis `n`, `f1` pour aller au '1', `r3` remplace par '3'. Ou `:%s/replicas: 1/replicas: 3/`.

scenario.en: Delete the third line entirely, then save.
scenario.fr: Supprimer entièrement la troisième ligne, puis sauvegarder.

challenge.initialBuffer:
line one
line two
line three
line four
line five
challenge.expectedBuffer:
line one
line two
line four
line five

explanation.en: `3G` jumps to line 3, `dd` deletes the line, `:wq` saves. (Or `3Gdd:wq`.)
explanation.fr: `3G` va à la ligne 3, `dd` supprime la ligne, `:wq` sauve.

scenario.en: Add a new line `  namespace: web` directly under the `metadata:` line. Save.
scenario.fr: Ajouter une nouvelle ligne `  namespace: web` juste sous la ligne `metadata:`. Sauvegarder.

en: `o` opens a new line BELOW in insert mode; `O` opens ABOVE.
fr: `o` ouvre une nouvelle ligne EN-DESSOUS en insert mode ; `O` AU-DESSUS.

challenge.initialBuffer:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: nginx
spec:
  containers:
  - name: nginx
challenge.expectedBuffer:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  namespace: web
  name: nginx
spec:
  containers:
  - name: nginx

explanation.en: Position on `metadata:`, `o`, type `  namespace: web`, Esc, `:wq`.
explanation.fr: Place le curseur sur `metadata:`, `o`, tape `  namespace: web`, Échap, `:wq`.

scenario.en: Duplicate the second line so it appears twice in a row. Save.
scenario.fr: Dupliquer la deuxième ligne pour qu'elle apparaisse deux fois d'affilée. Sauvegarder.

explanation.en: `2G` to line 2, `yy` yank the line, `p` paste below, `:wq`.
explanation.fr: `2G` ligne 2, `yy` copie la ligne, `p` colle dessous, `:wq`.

scenario.en: Indent every line by two spaces (already partially indented or not). Save.
scenario.fr: Indenter chaque ligne de deux espaces (déjà partiellement indenté ou pas). Sauvegarder.

explanation.en: `:%s/^/  /` prefixes every line with two spaces (the `^` anchor matches start of line).
explanation.fr: `:%s/^/  /` préfixe chaque ligne de deux espaces (`^` ancre le début de ligne).

scenario.en: Discard your changes and quit. The buffer should be left exactly as initially loaded.
scenario.fr: Abandonner les modifications et quitter. Le buffer doit rester exactement comme chargé.

challenge.initialBuffer:
important: data
keep: this
intact: yes
challenge.expectedBuffer:
important: data
keep: this
intact: yes

explanation.en: `:q!` quits without saving. The buffer in the simulator is the ground-truth at submit time, so leaving it untouched and submitting is correct.
explanation.fr: `:q!` quitte sans sauvegarder. Dans le simu, on compare le buffer à la soumission — laisser tel quel est correct.
